name: site_name
rule: Current public site name; aliases retained

name: ownership_category
rule: Ministry/member-owned/external labels are independent of affiliation

name: jurisdiction_profile
rule: Legal/geographic profile; never infer from zone

name: location
rule: Civil codes, coordinates/source/precision; manual address allowed

name: services
rule: Declared service catalogue, not confirmed readiness

name: capacity
rule: Defined capacity unit; not referral acceptance

name: indicator_values
rule: Counts/rates with source, unit and missingness

name: attestation
rule: Submitter declaration; separate from reviewer verification

name: findings
rule: Criterion, evidence, observation and severity-policy reference

name: recipient_refs
rule: Named team/facility/recipient; no universal public browse

name: parent_id
rule: Typed ministry relationship; no forced country level

name: requester_authority
rule: Verified right to act; minimum evidence

name: identifiers
rule: Issuing systems/local IDs or provisional status

name: birth_date
rule: Known/estimated with source; no inferred date

name: relationship
rule: Family relationship does not itself establish authority

name: measurements
rule: Typed values, units, effective time and method

name: content
rule: Actual authored narrative or structured references

name: attestation_context
rule: Intentional signer/privilege check occurs in command

name: condition_or_rejection
rule: Observed condition and reason; recollection task

name: results
rule: Value/code/text with unit, method, absence and reference context

name: critical_review
rule: Adopted trigger, actual acknowledgement and response

name: dose
rule: Exact decimal and unit; no default dose

name: timing
rule: Complete structured timing intent per clinical package

name: performed_at
rule: Actual event time; late entry explicit

name: second_check_ref
rule: Where required by approved high-risk policy

name: quantity
rule: Exact signed movement under direction rules

name: bed_id
rule: Actual accepted bed or explicit awaiting status

name: plan_task_refs
rule: Care-plan/MAR/tasks; do not duplicate dose events

name: safety_phases
rule: Actual applicable checks, participants and exceptions

name: amount
rule: Actual or explicitly pending amount state

name: service_privilege_packages
rule: Actual clinical scope and professional authority

name: readiness_test_refs
rule: Evidence including offline workflow and restore

name: clinical_instructions
rule: Approved signed plan or order references

name: review_context
rule: Actual progress, self-report attribution and revision
